boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Romeoville campus settings for solo work, group sessions, computer-based assignments, writing support, and outdoor reading.

cards.title: Settle In at the Library
cards.subtitle: Individual and group study across two LRC floors
cards.notes: Start here for a long work block; bring a device or use the public computers, scanners and printers documented by the university.
cards.short_summary: A flexible academic base with individual seating, group space and shared technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University states that its library occupies the first and second floors of the Learning Resource Center and provides individual and group study spaces, more than 50 public computers, scanners and printers.
cards.access_notes: Current summer hours through August 16 are Monday–Thursday 8:30 a.m.–9 p.m. and Friday 8:30 a.m.–noon; weekends are closed. Regular hours differ.

cards.entity_name: Lewis University Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Bookable rooms for current Lewis students
cards.notes: Reserve before meeting your group, then bring a Lewis photo ID to the Circulation Desk to check out the room key.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, enclosed option for collaborative academic work lasting up to three hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The library says current Lewis students may reserve or check out group study rooms for academic purposes for up to three hours per day; a Lewis photo ID is required for the key.
cards.access_notes: Available from library opening until 30 minutes before closing. Reserve online or call 815-836-5300; current students need a Lewis photo ID for the key.

cards.title: Work at the Library Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Campus computers inside the library
cards.notes: Use this stop for software or web-based work, but keep a backup location ready because scheduled classes can limit lab availability.
cards.short_summary: A staffed-hours computer option suited to assignments that need a campus workstation.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University lists a Library Computer Lab and states that computer labs may be unavailable during classroom use; the library also confirms computers are available to students during library hours.
cards.access_notes: The posted fall schedule lists Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m., Friday 7:30 a.m.–5 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; classroom use can override availability.

cards.title: Workshop a Draft at the Writing Center
cards.subtitle: First-floor library support for writing projects
cards.notes: Schedule a mentor session and bring one active draft or assignment; use the conversation to choose concrete revision steps.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative workspace for developing, revising and formatting academic writing.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University locates the Writing Center on the library's first floor and says mentors support writers at any stage through face-to-face, phone and video appointments.
cards.source_title: Center for Academic Success & Enrichment — Writing Center
cards.access_notes: Appointments are directed through the Writing Center's Appointments page. The center discusses one piece of writing per session and does not provide drop-off proofreading.

cards.title: Spread Out in CASE Commons
cards.subtitle: Third floor of the Learning Resource Center
cards.notes: Head to the LRC's third floor when you want a named indoor alternative to the library's first- and second-floor seating.
cards.short_summary: An upstairs commons identified by Lewis as an indoor campus hangout location.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's student resource guide identifies CASE Commons as an indoor location on the third floor of the Learning Resource Center.
cards.source_title: Resource Guide for Students — Hang Out Map
cards.access_notes: The official guide identifies the location but does not publish dedicated hours or unrestricted-access terms; follow current LRC building access and posted notices.

cards.title: Take Computer Work to CASE
cards.subtitle: Third-floor lab in the Learning Resource Center
cards.notes: Choose this third-floor lab for computer-centered coursework, and check posted availability before settling into a long session.
cards.short_summary: A named LRC computer lab separate from the library-floor workstation area.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's student resource guide lists the CASE Computer Lab on the third floor of the Learning Resource Center.
cards.source_title: Resource Guide for Students — Hang Out Map
cards.access_notes: The official guide identifies the lab but does not provide dedicated hours; computer labs can also be subject to scheduled use, so check posted access on arrival.

cards.title: Study in the Aviation Library
cards.subtitle: Harold E. White Aviation Center
cards.notes: Use this named aviation setting when your day already takes you to the White Aviation Center; verify building access before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A specialized study destination within Lewis University's aviation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's student resource guide identifies the Aviation Library inside the Harold E. White Aviation Center.
cards.source_title: Resource Guide for Students — Hang Out Map
cards.access_notes: The official guide names the space but publishes no dedicated hours or visitor-access terms; confirm current Aviation Center access before visiting.

cards.title: Set Up in Cordano Lounge
cards.subtitle: St. Charles Borromeo North Campus
cards.notes: Pair this lounge with classes or errands at St. Charles Borromeo, and confirm the building schedule before planning an extended block.
cards.short_summary: A named indoor lounge serving the university's north-campus complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's student resource guide lists Cordano Lounge as an indoor location at the St. Charles Borromeo North Campus.
cards.source_title: Resource Guide for Students — Hang Out Map
cards.access_notes: Located at the St. Charles Borromeo North Campus, accessed from 101 Airport Road. The guide does not state dedicated lounge hours or unrestricted access.

cards.title: Land at the Flight Deck
cards.subtitle: Indoor seating at St. Charles Borromeo
cards.notes: Bring a compact assignment to this named north-campus space, especially when your schedule already includes the College of Business complex.
cards.short_summary: An indoor St. Charles Borromeo destination documented on the student hangout map.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's student resource guide lists the Flight Deck as an indoor location at St. Charles Borromeo; the current campus map also places it in the St. Charles Borromeo building.
cards.access_notes: The current campus map places the Flight Deck at St. Charles Borromeo, accessed via 101 Airport Road. Dedicated hours and open-access terms are not published.

cards.title: Read Outside on the Library Veranda
cards.subtitle: Outdoor seating beside the Learning Resource Center
cards.notes: Take reading or low-tech review outside when conditions cooperate; keep the library nearby as a weather-ready fallback.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor library-side option for coursework that travels well beyond a desk.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's student resource guide identifies the Library Veranda as a named outdoor location on its Romeoville campus hangout map.
cards.source_title: Resource Guide for Students — Hang Out Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is weather-dependent. The university guide does not publish dedicated veranda hours; observe current campus and adjacent-library access notices.
